data.name: Sharvika
data.gender_notes: Sharvika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Goddess of Love and Beauty, Sharvika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘sharva’ meaning ‘auspicious’ and ‘ika’ meaning ‘one’. This name is believed to bring blessings of love, fertility, and happiness in one’s life. The name Sharvika carries the meaning “Goddess of Love” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharvika is a divine name, derived from the Goddess Sharvari. It is believed that the name Sharvika is blessed by the Goddess to bring love, happiness, and prosperity in the life of the child.
data.etymology: Sharvika belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvika total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
